entities.summary: Vasyl Mykhailovych Horbal is a Ukrainian politician and economist. Horbal formerly served as a People's Deputy of the Verkhovna Rada from 2002 to 2010, representing the Party of Regions, until he was appointed Governor of Lviv Oblast in April 2010. In December 2010, he was dismissed from the post of governor by Viktor Yanukovych after the Lviv Oblast Council expressed no confidence in Horbal. Prior to entering politics, Orbal served as an economist banker, and in 1996 became director of Ukrgasbank.
